en: Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a busy narrow street lined with tall brick buildings. Many people in early 20th‑century clothing stand or walk along the street, including women in long skirts and aprons, men in hats, and children. Shopfronts with awnings and large windows are visible on both sides. In the distance a church or tower rises above the rooftops. At the top of the card is printed text identifying the street and city.
